svg.title: The drone fixture on the shared-exclusion lattice
svg.desc: Left: the visual and radar bits about the horizontal target form the AND gate, with redundancy 0.085, two unique atoms of 0.131 and synergy 0.216 nats. Right: all 18 net atoms of visual, radar and acoustic bits about the volumetric target, in thousandths of a nat, on the redundancy lattice. The five atoms outside the down-set of the visual-radar pair add up to one quarter of log 2.
